note: Operator documentation audited end to end against v16.2.2. What was wrong: the public getting-started page carried EIGHT command examples that typed the RPC password straight into the command line (visible to every local user through ps), the published install script did the same and still taught --address instead of the SbPoW signing key, and the quickstart and mining pages did the same with an environment variable. All of them now use --rpc-pass-file with a mode-600 file, and every mining example selects the signing key with --wallet + --mining-key-label. A worse one, found by running the documented procedure instead of reading it: the NODE_BIND instructions could not work at all - sost-cli had no --mining-key-label flag and createnodebind always bound the key labelled 'default', so any operator whose mining key carries another label could not produce a valid bind. The CLI now takes the label and lists the wallet's labels when it cannot find the one you asked for. New page: sost-upgrade-v1622.html, the step-by-step upgrade for an already-running node and miner, with separate procedures for systemd, a manual terminal and WSL, RPC password generation and rotation, the 401 checklist, the optional v2 wallet with a recovery drill that never overwrites your only copy, NODE_BIND after #30,000, and rollback. The banner links to it. The window is unchanged: node AND miner, after #29,900 and before #30,000; consensus activates by itself at #30,000 and the first DTD Jackpot V2 is #30,186.
